summary: Markey voted to advance resolutions blocking sales of military bulldozers and 1,000-pound bomb bodies to Israel and voted Yea to discharge a broader arms-export disapproval resolution. In his 2026 primary victory speech he called to 'stop the bombing in Gaza' and slash the Pentagon budget. He co-signed a 2021 ceasefire appeal with 27 Senate colleagues, and Massachusetts Peace Action described him as opposing U.S. arms enabling the slaughter. Vote for Peace rates him Ally.
